description:
This is my one package road offering. The frame is made of a mix of Columbus Life and Spirit tubes-the lightest I work with. The brake routing is internal and the frame is fitted to a tapered steerer Enve road fork that is painted to match. The head tube sports a Jen Green sterling silver head badge. Frame weight is usually under 4 lbs. in the rim brake version. Also included is a Chris King tapered headset in your choice of color.

I don’t claim to make a luxury version of a welded frame but this is the top of the line of what I build. I offer it in this configuration because I know that it works really well.
